title: Installation
forbidden: The installation settings are for provider administrators. They apply to the whole server: {scope, select, organisation {your organisation} other {all tenants}}.
scoped: Your role in the provider team covers selected tenants only. The installation settings concern all tenants at once, so they are not available to you.

descriptions.server: How browsers reach this server and whether passkeys are offered. Applies to {scope, select, organisation {your organisation} other {all tenants}}.
descriptions.mail: The transport for reports, alerts and invitations. Used for {scope, select, organisation {your organisation} other {all tenants}}.
descriptions.microsoftApp: The app registration this installation uses to reach Microsoft 365.
descriptions.journal: The SMTP receiver for Exchange journal reports. One receiver serves {scope, select, organisation {your organisation} other {all tenants}}.
descriptions.defaultStorage: Where data is kept for {scope, select, organisation {your organisation} other {every tenant without a storage target of its own}}.
descriptions.providerApi: Keys for RMM and PSA tools that work across all tenants.
descriptions.updates: Which version runs, which releases exist and how to update.
descriptions.about: Version, source code and licenses of this installation.

access.owner: You can look at these settings. Changing them needs the Owner role in the provider team.
access.administrator: You can look at this page. Running the test needs the Administrator role in the provider team or higher.
access.demo: This is a public demo. These settings are read-only here.

locked.title: {section} is not unlocked yet
locked.description: The section stays greyed out in the menu until it is unlocked. The page that unlocks it explains what is needed.

facts.title: This server
facts.note: The public URL decides the passkey domain, the redirect addresses for Microsoft sign-in and the address agents enrol against.

notice.title: Operator notice
notice.description: The responsibility notice accepted when this installation was set up. It is shown for reference and cannot be changed.
notice.acceptedNoDate: Accepted (version {version}). The date was not recorded.
notice.outdated: A newer version of the notice ({current}) is waiting to be accepted. A provider administrator is asked to read it when signing in.
notice.none: The notice has not been accepted yet.

microsoftApp.optional: Optional. This app is only needed when {scope, select, organisation {your organisation is connected by a consent link instead of its own app} other {tenants are connected by a consent link instead of their own app}}.

defaultStorage.loadError: The default storage could not be read.

card.title: Default storage
card.description: Where data is kept when {scope, select, organisation {your organisation has} other {a tenant has}} no storage target of its own. The default comes from the server environment and cannot be changed here.

usage.label: In use by
usage.none: No tenant. Each tenant has a storage target of its own.
usage.organisationYes: Your organisation. It has no storage target of its own.
usage.organisationNo: Nobody. Your organisation has a storage target of its own.

misconfigured.title: The storage settings are invalid
misconfigured.description: STORAGE_TARGET, STORAGE_LOCAL_PATH or the S3_* values in the .env file of the server do not describe a usable storage. Correct them and restart {appName}.

test.title: Test
test.description: Writes, reads, lists and deletes a small object on the default and checks whether it can lock objects. The result is recorded in the audit log.
test.passed: The last test passed {when}, run by {who}.
test.failed: The last test failed {when}, run by {who}.

errors.misconfigured: The storage settings in the environment are invalid, so there is nothing to test.

journal.loadError: The journal receiver could not be read.

receiver.title: Receiver
receiver.description: {appName} accepts Exchange Online journal reports on this port. The values come from the server environment and are read when the API starts.

checklist.title: What Exchange Online needs from this server

journal.perTenant: The journal address of each tenant, its rotation and the guide for Exchange Online are on the Archive page of that tenant.

providerApi.intro: Provider keys read across all tenants, for RMM and PSA tools. A key belongs to this installation, not to one tenant.

moved.title: Provider keys moved
moved.description: The keys that work across all tenants are under Installation, Provider API now. This page keeps the keys of the active tenant.
